messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Release pipeline failed for sdk@4.0.0-tarball (sha256 mismatch) during canary rollout to api-prod. Auto-rollback triggered for 2 canaries, 5xx rate rising on /v1/paging from 0.05% to 4.2% in the last 10m.

maya: Saw the alert. Confirming - spikes correlate with customers using streaming + paging. Any known contract changes in 4.0?

alex: Yes — sdk@4.0 changed the streaming handshake slightly (frame header field order). We ran unit tests but not full integration with upstream proxies. I pushed the tarball earlier today.

samir: Reproduction in staging: when client sends frames with the new header order, gateway returns 400 and our client library retries but eventually triggers malformed frames that cause service to return 500s. Attaching quick log snippet:

```
ERROR ingress: decode_frame: unknown header ordering
WARN retry: stream aborted, request id=cli-7f3d
500 GET /v1/paging?cursor=abc123  — upstream: runtime: invalid_frame
```

maya: Nicole — any customer reports? Support queue just spiked with 3 tickets saying streaming disconnects.

nicole: Yup. Two enterprise customers on Dedicated reported sessions dropping and higher latencies. I've flagged them P1 and opened a ticket to notify account leads.

jordan: We need immediate mitigation: kill the feature flag that allows sdk v4 frames to be parsed, and revert the tarball publish. Can we flip the FF now?

release-manager: Rolling flag kill now: `ops/flags kill sdk_v4_frame_order` -> done. Noting it may take 60s to propagate to edge.

oncall-bot: FLAG UPDATE: sdk_v4_frame_order -> KILLED by release-manager at 2026-03-15T14:12:34Z.

maya: Monitoring metrics — 5xx rate dropped from 4.2% to 1.1% over the past 3m since flag kill. Still above baseline.

alex: Initiating tarball rollback: deprecate npm tag and publish patched 4.0.1 with fallback behavior. Commands I ran: `npm dist-tag rm redwood-sdk@latest 4.0.0 && npm deprecate redwood-sdk@4.0.0 "broken: use 3.x or 4.0.1"`

samir: Can we also add a runtime compatibility gate to reject new frame headers rather than crash? Quick diff I pushed to staging adds lenient parsing and returns 400 to client without 500.

maya: Good. Deploy that gate as a hotfix to ingress nodes. Who owns the deploy?

samir: I can ship a canary hotfix to ingress. Will route 5% of traffic for 5m then promote. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: ingress-hotfix-compat-gate v2026.03.15-1 -> canary 5%

2m later...

deploy-bot: Canary passed health checks. Promoting to 100% over 10m.

maya: 5xx back to baseline 0.06%. Paging performance recovered for most sessions.

nicole: CRM update: Notified impacted customers with interim mitigation notes. One customer requested an incident call — scheduled in 15m.

alex: Postmortem plan: root cause = SDK 4.0 handshake change + missing integration test against ingress parsing. Immediate fixes: revert tarball (done), publish 4.0.1 with backward-compatible handshake, add e2e test matrix (sdk versions x ingress versions), add pre-release integration gate to release checklist.

jordan: I'll own the postmortem write-up and the change to release checklist. Alex — you own the SDK patch. Samir — add compatibility gate and tests. Nicole — customer comms follow-up. Maya — please verify on-call timeline and whether handoff needed.

maya: On-call handoff: I'm on call until 17:00 UTC, Jordan will take over after that. Leaving a note in the rotation: incident reduced, monitoring in steady-state, ticket INC-4532 created.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: maya -> jordan at 17:00 UTC.

release-manager: Also raising follow-up: checksum verification step in pipeline didn't run because tarball artifact storage TTL expired and we used an ephemeral release flow. I'll open an RFC to force checksum verification in pipeline.

maya: Any remaining customer impact?

nicole: Two customers experienced >30s reconnect windows; both got interim mitigation. No data loss. Both accept postmortem and roadmap fixes.

alex: Working on 4.0.1 now — will tag release candidate and DM leads when ready. ETA 2h.

jordan: Great coordination. We'll keep this thread open until the rc is published and customer follow-ups are complete. Postmortem ETA 48h.

deploy-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: INC-4532 created by deploy-bot. Initial severity: Sev2.

maya: Closing loop — if anyone sees regression after 4.0.1 publish, ping #incidents immediately and @maya.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from jordan, :heart: from nicole)
